title: Hair growth promoting effects of andrographolide from Andrographis paniculata (Burm.f.) wall. ex nees: In vitro, in vivo, and molecular docking studies.
authors: Chen, ZiLiang; Luo, ShuLin; Hu, JingLu; Zhan, Xu; Tan, Yanlin; Leng, Jing; Lin, BoJie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究穿心莲内酯促毛发生长作用，分子对接仅涉及小分子与GSK3β蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Andrographis paniculata (Burm.f.) Wall. ex Nees has been used in Thai traditional medicine for topical hair growth promotion. This study investigates andrographolide(AP), a major bioactive compound from Andrographis paniculata, and its underlying mechanism. AIM OF THE STUDY: To evaluate the effect of AP on hair follicle growth and its regulation via the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Mouse vibrissae and human hair follicles were cultured with AP (0-10 muM) or minoxidil (10 muM). Hair shaft elongation and anagen duration were recorded. In vivo, depilated C57BL/6 mice received topical AP (1 or 5 mg/mL), with minoxidil as control. Follicular morphology was assessed by H&E staining; Ki67 expression was used to evaluate proliferation. Wnt/beta-catenin signaling was analyzed by qRT-PCR and Western blot. Molecular docking was performed to assess potential interactions between AP and key pathway proteins. RESULTS: AP significantly promoted hair shaft elongation and prolonged the anagen phase. At 5 muM, its efficacy was comparable to 10 muM minoxidil. In vivo, AP increased follicular density and Ki67-positive cells. Mechanistically, it upregulated Wnt family member 10b (Wnt10b), beta-catenin, and lymphoid enhancer-binding factor 1 (LEF1), indicating activation of the canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. Molecular docking analysis indicated that AP may bind to Glycogen Synthase Kinase 3 Beta(GSK3beta) with a favorable energy of -8.4 kcal/mol. CONCLUSIONS: AP, derived from Thai traditional hair care, promotes hair growth via follicular proliferation and Wnt/beta-catenin activation. In silico data hint at GSK3beta as a putative target, offering a mechanistic lead. This supports its development as a natural alopecia therapeutic, pending further validation.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：穿心莲（Andrographis paniculata (Burm.f.) Wall. ex Nees）在泰国传统医学中用于促进局部头发生长。本研究探讨穿心莲内酯（andrographolide, AP）——穿心莲中的一种主要生物活性化合物——及其潜在作用机制。研究目的：评估AP对毛囊生长的影响及其通过Wnt/β-catenin通路的调控作用。材料与方法：将小鼠触须和人毛囊与AP（0-10 μM）或米诺地尔（minoxidil, 10 μM）共培养，记录毛干伸长和生长期持续时间。在体内实验中，脱毛的C57BL/6小鼠接受局部AP（1或5 mg/mL）处理，以米诺地尔作为对照。通过H&E染色评估毛囊形态；使用Ki67表达评估增殖情况。通过qRT-PCR和Western blot分析Wnt/β-catenin信号通路。进行分子对接以评估AP与关键通路蛋白之间的潜在相互作用。结果：AP显著促进毛干伸长并延长生长期。在5 μM浓度下，其效果与10 μM米诺地尔相当。在体内，AP增加了毛囊密度和Ki67阳性细胞数量。机制上，它上调了Wnt家族成员10b（Wnt10b）、β-catenin和淋巴增强子结合因子1（LEF1），表明经典Wnt/β-catenin信号通路被激活。分子对接分析表明，AP可能与糖原合成酶激酶3β（GSK3β）结合，结合能为-8.4 kcal/mol。结论：源自泰国传统护发实践的AP通过促进毛囊增殖和激活Wnt/β-catenin通路来促进头发生长。计算机模拟数据提示GSK3β为潜在靶点，提供了机制线索。这支持其作为天然脱发治疗药物的开发，有待进一步验证。
